description: How readable is a website for AI agents? Checks llms.txt and llms-full.txt, AI crawler rules in robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, whether content renders without JavaScript, OpenAPI, MCP and x402 manifests, with a 0-100 score and fixes. Takes 2-5 s. Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
